user_prompt:
Extraia requisitos, atores, componentes, entidades e relações dos trechos abaixo. Responda só com o objeto JSON.

<trecho source_id="src-b7289a4c6c271454" chunk_id="chk-213fb4fe589f1824">
 The Disputes System must provide Search functionality.  The search method must include the ability to search by (1) the dispute case number  (2) the merchant account number  (3) the cardmember account number and (4) the issuer number.  In addition to the above criteria  the search functionality must further allow the user to limit the results of the search by a date range  the type of dispute (ticket retrieval request or chargeback notification)  the case status (open  closed or all) and the dispute reason code.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-b7289a4c6c271454" chunk_id="chk-178128b1dbdd1243">
The Disputes application must conform to the legal requirements as specified by Regulation E and Regulation Z that govern credit card disputes processing.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-b7289a4c6c271454" chunk_id="chk-8a6f79b924a476f1">
The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-b7289a4c6c271454" chunk_id="chk-e9cb8a5eb653d432">
The Disputes application shall manipulate and view business data. Users will not have direct access to data files or databases.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-b7289a4c6c271454" chunk_id="chk-5c8c55d41e499121">
The Disputes applications shall interface with the Merchant Information Database.  The Merchant Information Database provides detailed information with regard to the merchant. All merchant detail information shall be obtained from the Merchant Information Database.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-b7289a4c6c271454" chunk_id="chk-f5b176e144f7fa66">
All letter requests must be formatted according to guidelines specified by the Print Letter Utility system.
</trecho>

user_prompt:
Extraia requisitos, atores, componentes, entidades e relações dos trechos abaixo. Responda só com o objeto JSON.

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-8bcc7158f68aa87e">
The WCS system shall have the ability to include data for regions outside the United States and be accessed by users outside of the United States if approved by CCR management.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-1f7619362a2bab5f">
The interface shall be easy to use. 90% of users should be able to successfully use the system to generate a report on their first use. The interface should adhere to IBM usability standards.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-9ad19c2527009771">
Rreports must be easy to generate. eports must be generated within one button click and exported within one button click (after selecting the report)
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-ad706ca2844913f7">
The WCS system shall not allow automatic logins by any user. Cookies containing WCS login information about a user will not be stored on a user’s computer.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-43798829698970ab">
The WCS system shall have the ability to connect other designated WCS databases currently not included in the system.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-87c6c545a54e0ebe">
 All changes  updates  and additions to the WCS system shall be updated in the WCS Developer and WCS User Guides. Every change must be reflected in WCS system documentation
</trecho>

Extraia requisitos, atores, componentes, entidades e relações dos trechos abaixo. Responda só com o objeto JSON.

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-41570accbe902053">
The interface must summarize the data in a fashion that’s appealing to CCR management. Every report type must have at least one high level summary shown in the results dashboard/interface
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-9d1849d2caf3ca9e">
The WCS system shall use appropriate nomenclature and terminology as defined by the Corporate Community Grants organization. All interfaces and reports will undergo usability tests by CCR users.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-4004e1536efdfe8b">
The system shall use IBM and CCR branding standards. The interface must have one IBM logo and one CCR logo.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-d8cbe80c5a812d89">
The WCS system must run queries to the WCS databases once again (on a specified day) to update the available data available to CCR users. Queries must be made to external databases for data refresh once a week.
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-a28f82d07b52b3bb">
All CCR users shall receive training before the WCS system is deployed. One training session will be held for 100% of CCR users before system deployment (based on a CCR user being available)
</trecho>

<trecho source_id="src-a7eb1eb5c3878c87" chunk_id="chk-849b711fbe82a2e3">
The WCS system shall be available at all times as long as IBM’s internal intranet W3 is accessible. The WCS system will be available 95% of the time IBM’s internal intranet W3 is available.
</trecho>
